root_cause: SpringSimulation velocity was a 1 ms forward difference of position instead of the analytic derivative of each damping regime.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/physics.rs spring_solution() returns position and analytic derivative for overdamped, underdamped and critical forms in f64; SpringSimulation position/velocity/is_done use it
harness: physics__spring__damping_regimes and physics__scroll_spring__snap_when_done: pending rerun (harness build blocked by other workers)

root_cause: GravitySimulation.is_done compared signed position against end for negative acceleration; Flutter compares abs(x(t)) >= endDistance.

BoundedFrictionSimulation zeroed velocity at bounds and tested unclamped position with exact inequalities; Flutter keeps the friction dx and completes when the clamped position is strictly within tolerance.distance of a bound.
ClampedSimulation had no velocity bounds; Flutter dxMin/dxMax clamp the reported velocity.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/physics.rs ClampedSimulation::with_velocity_bounds; velocity clamped; harness/incular/tests/frames/physics.rs clamped twin now passes dxMin -50 / dxMax 50 matching the Flutter twin
harness: physics__clamped_simulation__position_and_velocity: pending rerun (diagnostic twin updated, shared harness file)
note: Shared-file edit: harness/incular/tests/frames/physics.rs (clamped and duration_bounce twins only).

root_cause: Friction and spring completion used inclusive comparisons; Flutter uses strict (nearZero / abs(dx) < tolerance).
SpringDescription::new and with_damping_ratio substituted defaults for nonpositive mass/stiffness and negative damping/ratio; Flutter stores the inputs unchanged.
api_change: behavior: invalid inputs are no longer sanitized; callers passing zero mass or negative damping now get Flutter arithmetic

root_cause: withDurationAndBounce used fractional seconds; Flutter truncates the duration to whole milliseconds.
limitations: A zero duration is clamped to 1 ms; Flutter asserts instead.

root_cause: SpringDescription lacked Flutter's derived duration and bounce getters.
harness: physics__spring_description__duration_bounce: diagnostic twin now uses spring.duration() and spring.bounce() (shared file edit)

change: crates/incular-animation/src/physics.rs SpringSimulation::with_snap_to_end; position/velocity snap when done

root_cause: FrictionSimulation implemented only exponential drag; Flutter also has constantDeceleration, the Newton-solved final time, through, finalX and timeAtX.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/physics.rs FrictionSimulation::with_constant_deceleration, through, final_x, time_at_x, build (10-iteration Newton final time)
api_change: additive; time_at_x returns Option<Duration> (None where Flutter returns infinity), not a bare f32
limitations: Negative Flutter times (unreachable past) map to None.

change: crates/incular-animation/src/physics.rs Simulation::tolerance (provided, default Tolerance::DEFAULT); set_tolerance on each concrete type; ClampedSimulation forwards

limitations: dyn Simulation cannot be mutated; RepeatingSimulation reports the default tolerance.
